model_visible_prompt:
Return only one JSON object with exactly the requested keys; numbers must be JSON numbers, null where requested; no prose or Markdown. Numeric tolerance is 0.000001.
Synoptic analyst: interpret these synthetic SYNOP section-1 excerpts, each sea-level pressure within 900–1099.9 hPa: report A: 11025 21048 49987; report B: 10008 21012 40032; report C: 11010 (dewpoint group absent; mean-sea-level pressure group absent). An absent group is unavailable, never zero; do not infer it. For each report return fields a_temp_c, a_dew_c, a_msl_hpa, a_spread_c, b_temp_c, b_dew_c, b_msl_hpa, b_spread_c, c_temp_c, c_dew_c, c_msl_hpa, c_spread_c. Spread is temperature minus dewpoint, null if either is unavailable. Also return b_minus_a_msl_hpa.
